title: You Think Finding Your Way Is Muscle Habit, Yet Single Brain Cells Draw Honeycomb Maps
description:
You think finding your way is blind muscle habit! Yet brain cells draw crystal honeycomb maps inside you! This is the true story of John O'Keefe and the Moser lab. Here is what went wrong with old habit theories.
